goal: Prevent debug assertion failures when an orphan transaction enters the mempool outside peer relay
Ensure package relay skips candidate child transactions that are already in the mempool
reviewability: Worthwhile now, but an agreed update to check by txid instead of wtxid is not yet pushed
agreement: Verified by reproducing the assertion failure on master and testing the fix (fametrano)
Agreed objection: checking wtxid misses orphans with different witnesses, fix awaited (marcofleon)
Withdrew objection to reactive cleanup after review (ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it prevents an assertion crash in debug builds when an orphan enters the mempool via RPC
The issue is limited to debug builds during an uncommon mix of RPC submission and peer relay
